turns.learner: Hello! Can you give me an exercise on word order (subject + verb + object)?
turns.tutor:
Look at this example: Anna (subject) eats (verb) rice (object) at noon (time). I put the doer first, then the action, then the thing, then the time.
Rule: Put the subject first, then the verb, then the object, then place or time.
Right: Tom kicks the ball at night. Wrong: Kicks Tom the ball at night.
Now it is your turn.
Put in order: "plays / Sam / chess / on Mondays"
